HIST 152.name: African American History
HIST 152.description: Chronological and topical survey of the history of African Americans from the colonial period to the early twenty-first century. Cross-listed with AFAM 152.

HIST 1.name: Western Civilization I
HIST 1.description: Survey of Western civilization from the ancient Mediterranean through Early Modern Europe.

HIST 2.name: Western Civilization II
HIST 2.description: Survey of Western civilization from Early Modern Europe to the present.

HIST 302W.name: Undergraduate Seminar
HIST 302W.description: Thematic or topical historical investigation in a seminar format, emphasizing historical criticism and analysis. Bulletin requires 4th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

HIST 21.name: American Civilization Since 1877
HIST 21.description: American civilization from 1877 to the present.
